name: Archdruid Devyric
location: Earthen Root Enclave, Path of the Salt Wind

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: We'll kill anyone who gets between us and our prize. That's your last warning, Laurel.
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive in the Earthen Root Enclave you will find several Storelore Circle Druids dead and Archdruid Devyric taunting Druid Laurel and Druid Lyam

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: We invited you in. We welcomed you!
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive in the Earthen Root Enclave you will find several Storelore Circle Druids dead and Archdruid Devyric taunting Druid Laurel and Druid Lyam

dialogue.speaker: Druid Lyam
dialogue.line: The seed, we can't let him take it!
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive in the Earthen Root Enclave you will find several Storelore Circle Druids dead and Archdruid Devyric taunting Druid Laurel and Druid Lyam

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: The Dais of Stonesight! It's wrong, like a gale offshore.
dialogue.trigger: When you are at the Dais of Stonesight, Druid Laurel will arrive, only to discover Archdruid Devyric leading the corruption of the Spirit of Stone.

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Keep the corruption going.
dialogue.trigger: When you are at the Dais of Stonesight, Druid Laurel will arrive, only to discover Archdruid Devyric leading the corruption of the Spirit of Stone.

dialogue.line: <Archdruid Devyric leaves.>
dialogue.trigger: When you are at the Dais of Stonesight, Druid Laurel will arrive, only to discover Archdruid Devyric leading the corruption of the Spirit of Stone.

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: Corruption? Stop this! Firesong, what are you doing?
dialogue.trigger: When you are at the Dais of Stonesight, Druid Laurel will arrive, only to discover Archdruid Devyric leading the corruption of the Spirit of Stone.

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: Spirit! Stop. Please stop!
dialogue.trigger: When you are at the Dais of Stonesight, Druid Laurel will arrive, only to discover Archdruid Devyric leading the corruption of the Spirit of Stone.

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: We can't let this corrupted spirit do more damage.
dialogue.trigger: When you are at the Dais of Stonesight, Druid Laurel will arrive, only to discover Archdruid Devyric leading the corruption of the Spirit of Stone.

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: It's down! Archdruid Devyric, stop right where you are!
dialogue.trigger: After destroying the second Trellis Sentinel, Druid Laurel will confront Archdruid Devyric near the Corruption of Root

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: Archdruid Devyric, stop this madness!
dialogue.trigger: After destroying the second Trellis Sentinel, Druid Laurel will confront Archdruid Devyric near the Corruption of Root

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Laurel, you know where the seed is, don't you? Come with me.
dialogue.trigger: After destroying the second Trellis Sentinel, Druid Laurel will confront Archdruid Devyric near the Corruption of Root

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Look down, Laurel. Do you see your rescue?
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Corruption of Root, you give chase after Devyric. He can been seen holding Laurel hostage while crossing a bridge

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: I don't. All I see is myself squashing your hope beneath my boot.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Corruption of Root, you give chase after Devyric. He can been seen holding Laurel hostage while crossing a bridge

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Still down there? Why won't you give up?
dialogue.trigger: He will taunt you as you progress the cliffs

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: I was personally sent by my leader. I will not fail her.
dialogue.trigger: He will taunt you as you progress the cliffs

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Stay up here, Laurel. This spirit will tell me what I want to know.
dialogue.trigger: Druid Laurel will call out, as Archdruid Devyric will be "questioning" the Spirit of Air

dialogue.speaker: Druid Laurel
dialogue.line: Think you'll find the seed? Your ego is blinding.
dialogue.trigger: Druid Laurel will call out, as Archdruid Devyric will be "questioning" the Spirit of Air

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Blinding? The seed is here. Well, there's no reason to keep you or the spirit now.
dialogue.trigger: Druid Laurel will call out, as Archdruid Devyric will be "questioning" the Spirit of Air

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: I have the Air's sight. I have the seed. You failed and all that's left to do is die!
dialogue.trigger: When you confront Archdruid Devyric

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: You won't keep me from my goal!
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: I will bring you down!
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Fall before me!
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Laurel's not the only one who can move rock.
dialogue.trigger: When he calls out stone attacks

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: I'll bury you in stone!
dialogue.trigger: When he calls out stone attacks

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Tremble before my mountainous power!
dialogue.trigger: When he calls out stone attacks

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: You won't survive this form!
dialogue.trigger: When he transforms in his Ursauk form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: I'll snap your neck with my paw!
dialogue.trigger: When he transforms in his Ursauk form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Hear that? You're being hunted!
dialogue.trigger: When he transforms in his Ursauk form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Feel my power!
dialogue.trigger: When he transforms in his Ursauk form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: Your blood will coat my snout!
dialogue.trigger: When he transforms in his Ursauk form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: This form is too good for you.
dialogue.trigger: When he changes back to human form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: The bear is too powerful, this can't end yet.
dialogue.trigger: When he changes back to human form

dialogue.speaker: Archdruid Devyric
dialogue.line: But I was chosen.
dialogue.trigger: When you have slain Archdruid Devyric, his final words will be

notes: Archdruid Devyric is the author of The Only Record of Our Plan.
related_quests: The Stonelore Defense: Repel the Firesong Circle's attack on Earthen Root Enclave.
Pledge: Earthen Root Enclave: Enter Earthen Root Enclave and return Undaunted.
summary: This article is about the boss. For the armor set, see Archdruid Devyric (set). Archdruid Devyric is a Breton archdruid of the Firesong Circle. He has the ability to shapeshift into an Ursauk at will. Devyric came to Earthen Root Enclave to steal the Stonelore Circle's sacred seed. You must chase him into the Deeproot and all the way to the Path of the Salt Wind, where he will absorb the island's Spirit of Air and attack. He serves as the dungeon's final boss.
